narrative.overview: The interface is a dark, neutral field for reviewing screenshots. Every piece of color on that field is a signal: green marks a box that will be redacted, orange marks one that has been excluded, red marks a box still being drawn. The chrome around the field — toolbar, tabs, settings, file list — stays OS-native and quiet, so the only thing that competes with the screenshot is the state of the redaction itself. The system is deliberately utilitarian. It inherits the host operating system's fonts and controls rather than imposing its own, which keeps the tool feeling like a native utility and removes every decorative decision. Personality is earned in one place: the dark viewer and its three-state color code. Everything else recedes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral viewer field (#333333) that isolates the screenshot.
Color used exclusively as redaction state; green = keep/selected, orange = excluded, red = in-progress.
OS-native chrome; no custom fonts, shadows, or decorations.
Square, high-contrast marks (3px outlines, white X handles) that read unambiguously over any image.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Signal Rule
rules.body: Color appears on the viewer only to mark redaction state. If a color on the canvas is not green, orange, or red, it is the screenshot, not the interface.

rules.name: The Dark Field Rule
rules.body: The viewer stays #333333. The field is dark so the screenshot is the subject and the signal colors never fight a white or patterned background.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: No custom fonts anywhere. Type stays the OS default so the tool reads native and never decorative.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Any perceived depth is the operating system's own widget chrome, never a custom shadow.

rules.name: The Square Mark Rule
rules.body: Redaction marks are square and sharp. No rounded corners, no soft edges — the mark must read as a deliberate selection boundary over any screenshot content.

dos: Keep the viewer field #333333; it is the one surface the app owns.
Use green (#00b050) only for a selected box and orange (#ff8c00) only for an excluded box; the color is the state.
Keep all chrome OS-native; the app adds no custom fonts, shadows, or radii to controls.
Draw redaction marks square, 3px, high-contrast, and over the image.
donts: Introduce color on the canvas that is not green, orange, or red; any other color will be read as screenshot content.
Add custom shadows, rounded corners, or decorative type; the incumbent system has none and stays native.
Dim or lighten the viewer background; #333333 is the contrast floor for the signal colors.
